scope.related_sources: LGlue1–3 and matching/code/template/driver/final-schema APIs, plus actual internal-induction and arithmetic-order APIs

theorem.name: LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.LGlue4.glue
theorem.gVal_meaning: The internal code of ∀t (M_j(t) → (relativize domL q ↔ envForm 0 q(t))). The source free variables remain free; IsFormula means bound-variable level zero, not a sentence.
theorem.all_internal_scope: C, j, and q range over an arbitrary IΣ₁ model. For nonstandard codes the conclusion is internal coded provability, not an assertion that a standard externally finite ZF derivation has been supplied.
theorem.budget: The theorem is stated with a fixed C to bound the universal j in the Σ₁ induction predicate. At an application one may choose C = j + formulaComplexity q. Thus the budget is not an external complexity cutoff; a separate budget-free corollary is not declared.
not_assumed: the desired glue as an additional premise

proof_structure: gVal_definable and GF_val/GF_of_gVal/gVal_of_GF bridge the represented code to the typed compiled-template conclusion.
case_rel and case_nrel reduce the two set-language relation tags and argument vectors to LGlue3.glue_atom; negG supplies the negative-atom step.
case_top, case_bot, case_and and case_or instantiate the fixed finite templates and use the same matching length j for connective children.

qPremise combines the IH for free p at j+1 with MT_succ, QX_free, relativize_free, envForm_free and shift_envForm, then generalizes. case_all/case_ex discharge functionality through fun_MT and invoke the corresponding finite compiled template.
The final proof invokes Foundation IsFormula.sigma1_structural_induction, whose genuine internal quantifier case recurses on free p. It does not recurse only over standard Lean syntax.

FvLt has a Δ₁ representation through total bindFreeAt and IsSemiformula. Together with the bounded j quantifier and Σ₁ coded proof witness, this supports the displayed Σ₁ induction predicate. The source uses definability rather than assuming that predicate.

complexity_free preserves child complexity under opening; a binder increases j by one while decreasing complexity by one. Connective max-plus-one budgets are monotone. The installed Mathlib mul_le_mul_right (to_additive) adds on the left, so the four add_le_add_right calls have the required orientation.
remaining_obligations: Internally prove existence of an environment satisfying M_j, with the appropriate L-domain and earlier-stage boundedness properties needed by the reflection driver. Functionality and slot reading of an already matched environment do not prove existence.
Compile and combine the already available final Separation/Replacement templates with the driver, the glue, and suitable matching environments for all internal schema core codes.

Peel and rebuild the internal universal closures recognized by SchemaClosure/SchemaRecognizer, tracking relativize and domSet side formulas, to discharge ConstructibleInterpretation.provable_falsum_ZF_of_ZFC.hSchema.

The final hSchema target remains internal Derivable ZF of insert (relativize domL p) (domSet domL m) for every internal recognized Separation/Replacement axiom. LGlue4 does not itself assert this theorem or the PA nonhalting/consistency endpoint.
